bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'SOURCE_HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'SOURCE_BRANCH='; git branch --show-current
printf 'SOURCE_DIRTY='; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" && echo NO || echo YES
printf 'CONTAINERS\n'; docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Image}} {{.Status}}' | grep -Ei 'video|sticker' || true
printf 'IMAGE_TAGS\n'; docker image ls --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}} {{.ID}}' | grep -Ei 'video|sticker' || true
printf 'RUNTIME_PATHS\n'; ls -d "$HOME"/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/sticker-poll-* 2>/dev/null | tail -n 4 || true
